show_banner_ads.description: Enable the bottom banner ad. Turn on once install volume justifies it.

show_interstitial_ads.description: Enable the full-screen interstitial shown after export. Keep off until install base is established.

show_native_ads.description: Enable native ads on tool screens and the saved-files list.

show_app_open_ads.description: Enable the app-open ad shown when returning to the app from background.
